title: Primary reason and rating prompts
summary: This topic is dominated by survey-prompt text about the primary reason for a rating, with only one clear complaint mentioning remote start and remote parking affecting the score.

negative.summary: The only clear negative example says remote start and remote parking kept the reviewer from giving a perfect rating.

undetermined.summary: Most examples are non-opinion survey wording or vague statements about a main reason for choosing or keeping a vehicle, so the underlying sentiment cannot be determined from the fragments alone.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are generic survey prompts rather than substantive feedback, which limits interpretability.
The topic mixes prompt text with a small number of actual reason statements, so it is not a coherent vehicle-aspect theme.
Examples are insufficient to determine consistent customer sentiment beyond the single negative fragment.
